items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: when Harry damaged himself punching through a plate glass window, I rejoined Boyd... He rejoined them in San Francisco... I went back and rejoined the band

ctx.x: I didn't know that Harry wrote.
I think his name is on "Boyd's Nest". I may be wrong about that, but I believe his name is on top of "Boyd's Nest."
